name: Minneapolis
living: the gold crown of the tallest tower glows and a slow glint rises up its spire
office windows in the glass towers flicker on and off one by one
the blue-lit tower's halo ring pulses softly
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly on top of the skyline
stars twinkle in the deepening indigo sky
thin violet clouds drift slowly past the skyline (sky layer drift)
the big video board's crescent moon and pixel cloud drift gently across its screen
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths and dust motes drifting in their cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
